method: Headless Chromium using an in-memory HTML harness with local assets inlined; not a hosted deployment test.

interactionChecks.signupAndLoginFlow: Passed using a deterministic passwordDigest stub in the browser harness; actual PBKDF2 was separately verified with Node WebCrypto.

security.passwordHash: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256, 120000 iterations, 16-byte random salt, 256-bit derived output; separately verified with Node WebCrypto.
security.accountScope: Local browser only; no backend, server authentication, or cross-device synchronization.
security.note: The browser harness used an auth digest stub only for the signup/login UI flow because the harness runs on an opaque about:blank origin without WebCrypto. The delivered app retains the real WebCrypto PBKDF2 implementation.

limitations: The delivered file:// package was not opened directly in the sandbox browser due environment navigation restrictions; assets were loaded into an in-memory browser harness.
No backend, online authentication, payment gateway, bank submission, or live bank data feed is included.
This QA is a prototype smoke test, not a production penetration test or full cross-browser acceptance test.
